e: Given x = 3^(1/3) + 3^(-1/3). Cubing both sides (दोनों पक्षों का घन करने पर): x³ = (3^(1/3))³ + (3^(-1/3))³ + 3·3^(1/3)·3^(-1/3)·(3^(1/3) + 3^(-1/3)) ⇒ x³ = 3 + 1/3 + 3(1)x ⇒ x³ = 10/3 + 3x. Multiplying both sides by 3 (दोनों पक्षों को 3 से गुणा करने पर): 3x³ = 10 + 9x ⇒ 3x³ − 9x = 10. Hence, option B is correct.
qe: If x = 3^(1/3) + 3^(-1/3), then what is the value of 3x³ − 9x?

q: समीकरण 2^(log₃ x) + x^(log₃ 2) = 16 को संतुष्ट करने वाला x का वास्तविक मान क्या है?
e: Using the logarithmic identity a^(log_c b) = b^(log_c a) (लघुगणक के गुणधर्म a^(log_c b) = b^(log_c a) से), we have x^(log₃ 2) = 2^(log₃ x). Thus, the equation becomes 2·2^(log₃ x) = 16 ⇒ 2^(log₃ x) = 8 = 2³. Comparing exponents (घातों की तुलना करने पर): log₃ x = 3 ⇒ x = 3³ = 27. Hence, option C is correct.
qe: What is the real value of x satisfying the equation 2^(log₃ x) + x^(log₃ 2) = 16?

q: यदि log₁₂ 18 = a तथा log₂₄ 54 = b हो, तो ab + 5(a − b) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
e: Let x = log₂ 3 (माना x = log₂ 3). Converting both to base 2: a = log₂(2×3²) / log₂(2²×3) = (1 + 2x)/(2 + x), and b = log₂(2×3³) / log₂(2³×3) = (1 + 3x)/(3 + x). Now, ab + 5(a − b) = [(1 + 2x)(1 + 3x) + 5{(1 + 2x)(3 + x) − (1 + 3x)(2 + x)}] / [(2 + x)(3 + x)]. Numerator = (1 + 5x + 6x²) + 5[(3 + 7x + 2x²) − (2 + 7x + 3x²)] = (1 + 5x + 6x²) + 5(1 − x²) = 6 + 5x + x² = (2 + x)(3 + x). Dividing by the denominator (2 + x)(3 + x) gives 1. (अतः मान 1 है।)
qe: If log₁₂ 18 = a and log₂₄ 54 = b, then find the value of ab + 5(a − b).

q: 7¹⁰³ को 25 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल क्या प्राप्त होगा?
e: We can write 7¹⁰³ = 7 × (7²)⁵¹ = 7 × (49)⁵¹. Since 49 = 50 − 1 ≡ −1 (mod 25), we get 7¹⁰³ ≡ 7 × (−1)⁵¹ = −7 (mod 25). Adding 25 to obtain the least non-negative remainder (धनात्मक शेषफल के लिए 25 जोड़ने पर): −7 + 25 = 18. Hence, the remainder is 18.
qe: What is the remainder when 7¹⁰³ is divided by 25?

q: 12 की वह अधिकतम घात ज्ञात कीजिए जो 50! (क्रमगुणित 50) को पूर्णतः विभाजित करती है।
e: Prime factorization of 12 is 2² × 3. Using Legendre's formula (लेजेन्ड्रे सूत्र द्वारा), the exponent of 2 in 50! is ⌊50/2⌋ + ⌊50/4⌋ + ⌊50/8⌋ + ⌊50/16⌋ + ⌊50/32⌋ = 25 + 12 + 6 + 3 + 1 = 47. So the exponent of 2² (= 4) in 50! is ⌊47/2⌋ = 23. The exponent of 3 in 50! is ⌊50/3⌋ + ⌊50/9⌋ + ⌊50/27⌋ = 16 + 5 + 1 = 22. Therefore, the highest power of 12 = 2² × 3 is min(23, 22) = 22. (अतः अधिकतम घात 22 है।)
qe: Find the highest power of 12 that exactly divides 50! (factorial 50).

q: यदि a/(b + c) = b/(c + a) = c/(a + b) = k (जहाँ a, b, c अशून्य वास्तविक संख्याएँ हैं), तो k के सभी संभावित मान हैं:
e: From the given equations: a = k(b + c), b = k(c + a), c = k(a + b). Adding all three (तीनों समीकरणों को जोड़ने पर): a + b + c = 2k(a + b + c) ⇒ (a + b + c)(1 − 2k) = 0. Case 1: If a + b + c ≠ 0, then 1 − 2k = 0 ⇒ k = 1/2. Case 2: If a + b + c = 0, then b + c = −a, so k = a/(−a) = −1. Thus, k can be 1/2 or −1.
qe: If a/(b + c) = b/(c + a) = c/(a + b) = k (where a, b, c are non-zero real numbers), then all possible values of k are:

q: 200 विद्यार्थियों के एक सर्वेक्षण में 120 गणित, 90 भौतिकी, 70 रसायन विज्ञान, 40 गणित व भौतिकी दोनों, 30 भौतिकी व रसायन दोनों, 50 गणित व रसायन दोनों पढ़ते हैं तथा 20 विद्यार्थी इनमें से कोई भी विषय नहीं पढ़ते। केवल गणित पढ़ने वाले विद्यार्थियों की संख्या कितनी है?
e: Number of students studying at least one subject: n(M ∪ P ∪ C) = 200 − 20 = 180. By Inclusion-Exclusion Principle (समावेश-अपवर्जन सिद्धांत से): n(M ∪ P ∪ C) = n(M) + n(P) + n(C) − n(M ∩ P) − n(P ∩ C) − n(M ∩ C) + n(M ∩ P ∩ C) ⇒ 180 = 120 + 90 + 70 − 40 − 30 − 50 + n(M ∩ P ∩ C) ⇒ 180 = 160 + n(M ∩ P ∩ C) ⇒ n(M ∩ P ∩ C) = 20. Students studying ONLY Mathematics (केवल गणित) = n(M) − n(M ∩ P) − n(M ∩ C) + n(M ∩ P ∩ C) = 120 − 40 − 50 + 20 = 50.
qe: In a survey of 200 students, 120 study Mathematics, 90 study Physics, 70 study Chemistry, 40 study both Mathematics and Physics, 30 study both Physics and Chemistry, 50 study both Mathematics and Chemistry, and 20 study none of these three subjects. How many students study ONLY Mathematics?

q: जब किसी बहुपद P(x) को (x − 2) तथा (x − 3) से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेषफल क्रमशः 5 और 7 प्राप्त होते हैं। P(x) को (x − 2)(x − 3) से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल क्या होगा?
e: By Remainder Theorem (शेषफल प्रमेय से), P(2) = 5 and P(3) = 7. When divided by quadratic (x − 2)(x − 3), the remainder has degree at most 1, so let R(x) = Ax + B. Then P(x) = Q(x)(x − 2)(x − 3) + Ax + B. Putting x = 2: 2A + B = 5; putting x = 3: 3A + B = 7. Subtracting gives A = 2, and B = 5 − 4 = 1. Thus, the remainder is 2x + 1.
qe: When a polynomial P(x) is divided by (x − 2) and (x − 3), the remainders are 5 and 7 respectively. What is the remainder when P(x) is divided by (x − 2)(x − 3)?

q: यदि बहुपदों P(x) = x³ + ax² + bx + 6 तथा Q(x) = x² − 5x + 6 का म.स.प. (HCF) (x − 2)(x − 3) है, तो (a + b) का मान क्या है?
e: Since (x − 2)(x − 3) is the HCF, both x = 2 and x = 3 are roots of P(x) = 0 (अतः x = 2 व 3, P(x) के शून्यक हैं). Putting x = 2: 8 + 4a + 2b + 6 = 0 ⇒ 2a + b = −7 ... (i). Putting x = 3: 27 + 9a + 3b + 6 = 0 ⇒ 3a + b = −11 ... (ii). Subtracting (i) from (ii): a = −4. Substituting into (i): b = −7 − 2(−4) = 1. Hence, a + b = −4 + 1 = −3.
qe: If the HCF of the polynomials P(x) = x³ + ax² + bx + 6 and Q(x) = x² − 5x + 6 is (x − 2)(x − 3), then what is the value of (a + b)?

q: यदि x² − 3x + 1 = 0 हो, तो x⁵ + 1/x⁵ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
e: Dividing x² − 3x + 1 = 0 by x (since x ≠ 0): x + 1/x = 3. Now, x² + 1/x² = (x + 1/x)² − 2 = 3² − 2 = 7. Also, x³ + 1/x³ = (x + 1/x)³ − 3(x + 1/x) = 27 − 9 = 18. Using the identity (सर्वसमिका से): (x² + 1/x²)(x³ + 1/x³) = (x⁵ + 1/x⁵) + (x + 1/x) ⇒ 7 × 18 = (x⁵ + 1/x⁵) + 3 ⇒ x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = 126 − 3 = 123.
qe: If x² − 3x + 1 = 0, then find the value of x⁵ + 1/x⁵.

q: k के किस मान के लिए रैखिक समीकरण निकाय kx + 3y = k − 3 तथा 12x + ky = k का कोई हल नहीं होगा?
e: For no solution (कोई हल न होने की शर्त): a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂ ⇒ k/12 = 3/k ≠ (k − 3)/k. From k/12 = 3/k, we get k² = 36 ⇒ k = 6 or k = −6. Checking k = 6: 6/12 = 3/6 = 1/2 and (6 − 3)/6 = 3/6 = 1/2 (infinitely many solutions, rejected). Checking k = −6: −6/12 = 3/(−6) = −1/2, while (−6 − 3)/(−6) = 9/6 = 3/2 ≠ −1/2. Thus, only k = −6 gives no solution.
qe: For what value of k does the system of linear equations kx + 3y = k − 3 and 12x + ky = k have NO solution?

e: Let u = 1/x, v = 1/y, w = 1/z. Then u + v = 10/12, v + w = 7/12, w + u = 9/12. Adding all three equations (तीनों को जोड़ने पर): 2(u + v + w) = (10 + 7 + 9)/12 = 26/12 ⇒ u + v + w = 13/12. Subtracting each equation individually: u = 13/12 − 7/12 = 6/12 = 1/2 ⇒ x = 2; v = 13/12 − 9/12 = 4/12 = 1/3 ⇒ y = 3; w = 13/12 − 10/12 = 3/12 = 1/4 ⇒ z = 4. Therefore, x + y + z = 2 + 3 + 4 = 9.
qe: If 1/x + 1/y = 5/6, 1/y + 1/z = 7/12, and 1/z + 1/x = 3/4, then find the value of x + y + z.

q: यदि द्विघात समीकरणों x² + px + q = 0 तथा x² + qx + p = 0 (जहाँ p ≠ q) का एक मूल उभयनिष्ठ है, तो उनके शेष दो मूलों से बनने वाला द्विघात समीकरण क्या होगा?
e: Let α be the common root (माना उभयनिष्ठ मूल α है). Then α² + pα + q = 0 and α² + qα + p = 0. Subtracting gives (p − q)α − (p − q) = 0 ⇒ (p − q)(α − 1) = 0. Since p ≠ q, α = 1. Substituting α = 1 gives 1 + p + q = 0 ⇒ p + q = −1. By product of roots, the other root of the first equation is q/1 = q, and of the second is p/1 = p. Thus, the equation with roots p and q is x² − (p + q)x + pq = 0 ⇒ x² + x + pq = 0.
qe: If the quadratic equations x² + px + q = 0 and x² + qx + p = 0 (where p ≠ q) have a common root, then the quadratic equation whose roots are their remaining two roots is:

q: x के सभी वास्तविक मानों के लिए परिमेय व्यंजक (x² − x + 1) / (x² + x + 1) का अधिकतम मान क्या है?
e: Let y = (x² − x + 1)/(x² + x + 1). Cross-multiplying: (y − 1)x² + (y + 1)x + (y − 1) = 0. Since x is real (चूँकि x वास्तविक है), discriminant Δ ≥ 0 ⇒ (y + 1)² − 4(y − 1)² ≥ 0 ⇒ [(y + 1) − 2(y − 1)][(y + 1) + 2(y − 1)] ≥ 0 ⇒ (3 − y)(3y − 1) ≥ 0 ⇒ (y − 1/3)(y − 3) ≤ 0 ⇒ 1/3 ≤ y ≤ 3. Hence, the maximum value is 3 (attained at x = −1).
qe: For all real values of x, what is the maximum value of the rational expression (x² − x + 1) / (x² + x + 1)?

q: यदि α, β, γ त्रिघात समीकरण x³ − 2x² + 3x − 4 = 0 के मूल हों, तो α³ + β³ + γ³ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
e: By Vieta's formulas (वीटा के सूत्रों से): ∑α = 2, ∑αβ = 3, αβγ = 4. First, ∑α² = (∑α)² − 2∑αβ = 2² − 2(3) = −2. Since α, β, γ satisfy x³ = 2x² − 3x + 4, summing over all three roots (तीनों मूलों का योग करने पर): ∑α³ = 2∑α² − 3∑α + 4(3) = 2(−2) − 3(2) + 12 = −4 − 6 + 12 = 2.
qe: If α, β, γ are the roots of the cubic equation x³ − 2x² + 3x − 4 = 0, then find the value of α³ + β³ + γ³.

q: यदि α, β, γ समीकरण x³ − 3x² + 2x − 1 = 0 के मूल हैं, तो वह त्रिघात समीकरण जिसके मूल α/(β + γ), β/(γ + α) तथा γ/(α + β) हैं, होगा:
e: Here α + β + γ = 3, so β + γ = 3 − α. Let the transformed root be y = α/(3 − α) (रूपांतरण y = x/(3 − x) लेने पर). Solving for x: 3y − xy = x ⇒ x = 3y/(1 + y). Substituting x = 3y/(1 + y) into x³ − 3x² + 2x − 1 = 0 and multiplying by (1 + y)³: 27y³ − 27y²(1 + y) + 6y(1 + y)² − (1 + y)³ = 0 ⇒ 27y³ − 27y² − 27y³ + (6y + 12y² + 6y³) − (1 + 3y + 3y² + y³) = 0 ⇒ 5y³ − 18y² + 3y − 1 = 0.
qe: If α, β, γ are the roots of x³ − 3x² + 2x − 1 = 0, then the cubic equation whose roots are α/(β + γ), β/(γ + α), and γ/(α + β) is:

q: देकार्त के चिह्न नियम (Descartes' rule of signs) का उपयोग करते हुए, समीकरण x⁵ + 3x³ + 2x − 5 = 0 के अवास्तविक (सम्मिश्र) मूलों की न्यूनतम संख्या क्या है?
e: Let f(x) = x⁵ + 3x³ + 2x − 5. The sign sequence of coefficients in f(x) is (+, +, +, −), which has 1 sign change ⇒ at most 1 positive real root (अधिकतम 1 धनात्मक वास्तविक मूल). Now f(−x) = −x⁵ − 3x³ − 2x − 5 has sign sequence (−, −, −, −), which has 0 sign changes ⇒ 0 negative real roots (0 ऋणात्मक मूल). Also f(0) = −5 ≠ 0, so 0 is not a root. Thus, total real roots ≤ 1, meaning at least 5 − 1 = 4 roots must be non-real.
qe: Using Descartes' rule of signs, what is the minimum number of non-real (complex) roots of the equation x⁵ + 3x³ + 2x − 5 = 0?

q: यदि त्रिघात समीकरण x³ − 12x² + 39x − k = 0 के मूल समांतर श्रेणी (AP) में हैं, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
e: Let the roots in AP be (a − d), a, (a + d) (माना AP में मूल a − d, a, a + d हैं). Sum of roots = (a − d) + a + (a + d) = 3a = 12 ⇒ a = 4. Since x = 4 is a root of the equation, substituting x = 4 gives: 4³ − 12(4²) + 39(4) − k = 0 ⇒ 64 − 192 + 156 − k = 0 ⇒ 28 − k = 0 ⇒ k = 28. (The roots are 1, 4, 7.)
qe: If the roots of the cubic equation x³ − 12x² + 39x − k = 0 are in Arithmetic Progression (AP), then find the value of k.

q: व्युत्क्रम समीकरण 2x⁴ − 9x³ + 14x² − 9x + 2 = 0 के सभी भिन्न (distinct) वास्तविक मूलों का योग क्या है?
e: Dividing by x² (x² से भाग देने पर): 2(x² + 1/x²) − 9(x + 1/x) + 14 = 0. Put t = x + 1/x, so x² + 1/x² = t² − 2. Then 2(t² − 2) − 9t + 14 = 0 ⇒ 2t² − 9t + 10 = 0 ⇒ (2t − 5)(t − 2) = 0 ⇒ t = 5/2 or t = 2. For t = 5/2: x + 1/x = 5/2 ⇒ x = 2 or x = 1/2. For t = 2: x + 1/x = 2 ⇒ (x − 1)² = 0 ⇒ x = 1 (repeated root). Thus, the distinct real roots are 2, 1/2, and 1, whose sum is 2 + 1/2 + 1 = 7/2.
qe: What is the sum of all DISTINCT real roots of the reciprocal equation 2x⁴ − 9x³ + 14x² − 9x + 2 = 0?

q: 'a' के उन सभी वास्तविक मानों का समुच्चय ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके लिए द्विघात समीकरण x² − 2ax + a² + a − 3 = 0 के दोनों मूल वास्तविक तथा 3 से पूर्णतः छोटे हों।
e: Let f(x) = x² − 2ax + a² + a − 3. For both roots to be real and less than 3 (दोनों मूल वास्तविक व 3 से छोटे होने की तीन शर्तें): (1) Discriminant Δ ≥ 0 ⇒ 4a² − 4(a² + a − 3) ≥ 0 ⇒ 12 − 4a ≥ 0 ⇒ a ≤ 3. (2) Vertex x-coordinate −b/(2A) < 3 ⇒ a < 3. (3) f(3) > 0 ⇒ 9 − 6a + a² + a − 3 > 0 ⇒ a² − 5a + 6 > 0 ⇒ (a − 2)(a − 3) > 0 ⇒ a < 2 or a > 3. Taking the intersection of (1), (2), and (3) gives a < 2.
qe: Find the set of all real values of 'a' for which both roots of the quadratic equation x² − 2ax + a² + a − 3 = 0 are real and strictly less than 3.

q: 3×3 सारणिक Δ = | a − b − c   2a   2a ; 2b   b − c − a   2b ; 2c   2c   c − a − b | का मान क्या है?
e: Apply row operation R₁ → R₁ + R₂ + R₃ (पंक्ति संक्रिया R₁ → R₁ + R₂ + R₃ लगाने पर). Every element of R₁ becomes (a + b + c). Taking (a + b + c) common from R₁, R₁ becomes [1, 1, 1]. Next apply C₂ → C₂ − C₁ and C₃ → C₃ − C₁, yielding an upper/lower triangular form with diagonal entries 1, −(a + b + c), and −(a + b + c). Therefore, Δ = (a + b + c) × 1 × [−(a + b + c)] × [−(a + b + c)] = (a + b + c)³.
qe: What is the value of the 3×3 determinant Δ = | a − b − c   2a   2a ; 2b   b − c − a   2b ; 2c   2c   c − a − b |?

q: यदि A एक 3×3 वर्ग आव्यूह है जिसका सारणिक |A| = 4 है, तो |2·adj(A)| का मान क्या होगा?
e: For an n×n matrix, |k·B| = kⁿ|B| and |adj(A)| = |A|^(n−1) (गुणधर्म: |k·B| = kⁿ|B| तथा |adj(A)| = |A|^(n−1)). Here n = 3 and k = 2, so |2·adj(A)| = 2³ · |adj(A)| = 8 · |A|^(3−1) = 8 · |A|² = 8 × 4² = 8 × 16 = 128.
qe: If A is a 3×3 square matrix such that |A| = 4, then what is the value of |2·adj(A)|?

q: यदि ω इकाई का एक अवास्तविक घनमूल हो, तो सारणिक Δ = | x + 1   ω   ω² ; ω   x + ω²   1 ; ω²   1   x + ω | का मान क्या है?
e: Using 1 + ω + ω² = 0 and ω³ = 1, apply C₁ → C₁ + C₂ + C₃ (स्तंभ संक्रिया C₁ → C₁ + C₂ + C₃ लगाने पर). Every entry of C₁ becomes x + 1 + ω + ω² = x. Factoring out x, C₁ = [1, 1, 1]ᵀ. Now apply R₂ → R₂ − R₁ and R₃ → R₃ − R₁: Δ = x · | 1  ω  ω² ; 0  x + ω² − ω  1 − ω² ; 0  1 − ω  x + ω − ω² | = x[(x + ω² − ω)(x + ω − ω²) − (1 − ω)(1 − ω²)]. Expanding: x[x² − (ω² − ω)² − (1 − ω − ω² + ω³)] = x[x² − (ω − 2 + ω²) − (2 − (−1))] = x[x² − (−3) − 3] = x³.
qe: If ω is a non-real cube root of unity, then what is the value of the determinant Δ = | x + 1   ω   ω² ; ω   x + ω²   1 ; ω²   1   x + ω |?

q: यदि a, b, c त्रिघात समीकरण x³ − 3x² + 2x − 5 = 0 के मूल हैं, तो सारणिक Δ = | 1 + a   1   1 ; 1   1 + b   1 ; 1   1   1 + c | का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
e: By standard determinant expansion (सारणिक का प्रसार करने पर): Δ = abc(1 + 1/a + 1/b + 1/c) = abc + ab + bc + ca. From the cubic equation x³ − 3x² + 2x − 5 = 0, Vieta's formulas give ab + bc + ca = 2 and abc = 5. Substituting these values: Δ = 5 + 2 = 7. (अतः सारणिक का मान 7 है।)
qe: If a, b, c are the roots of the cubic equation x³ − 3x² + 2x − 5 = 0, then find the value of the determinant Δ = | 1 + a   1   1 ; 1   1 + b   1 ; 1   1   1 + c |.

q: रैखिक समीकरण निकाय x + y + z = 6, x + 2y + 3z = 10 तथा x + 2y + λz = μ का कोई हल नहीं होगा यदि:
e: Coefficient determinant Δ = | 1  1  1 ; 1  2  3 ; 1  2  λ | = 1(2λ − 6) − 1(λ − 3) + 1(2 − 2) = λ − 3. For no solution (कोई हल न होने के लिए), Δ = 0 ⇒ λ = 3. Substituting λ = 3 into the third equation gives x + 2y + 3z = μ, while the second equation is x + 2y + 3z = 10. These two parallel planes are inconsistent (असंगत) if and only if μ ≠ 10. Hence, λ = 3 and μ ≠ 10.
qe: The system of linear equations x + y + z = 6, x + 2y + 3z = 10, and x + 2y + λz = μ has NO solution if:

q: k के किस मान के लिए समघात समीकरण निकाय x + ky + 3z = 0, 3x + ky − 2z = 0 तथा 2x + 3y − 4z = 0 का एक अतुच्छ (non-trivial) हल विद्यमान होगा?
e: For a non-trivial solution of a homogeneous system, Δ = 0 (अतुच्छ हल के लिए सारणिक Δ = 0 होना चाहिए). So | 1  k  3 ; 3  k  −2 ; 2  3  −4 | = 0. Expanding along R₁: 1(−4k + 6) − k(−12 + 4) + 3(9 − 2k) = 0 ⇒ −4k + 6 + 8k + 27 − 6k = 0 ⇒ −2k + 33 = 0 ⇒ k = 33/2.
qe: For what value of k does the homogeneous system of equations x + ky + 3z = 0, 3x + ky − 2z = 0, and 2x + 3y − 4z = 0 possess a non-trivial solution?

q: यदि a, b, c धनात्मक वास्तविक संख्याएँ हैं जो सभी बराबर नहीं हैं, तो चक्रीय सारणिक Δ = | a  b  c ; b  c  a ; c  a  b | का मान सदैव होता है:
e: Expanding the determinant: Δ = 3abc − a³ − b³ − c³ = −(a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca) = −(1/2)(a + b + c)[(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²]. Since a, b, c > 0, (a + b + c) > 0. Since a, b, c are not all equal (चूँकि a, b, c सभी समान नहीं हैं), [(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²] > 0. Due to the negative sign outside, Δ is always strictly negative (सदैव ऋणात्मक).
qe: If a, b, c are positive real numbers not all equal, then the value of the circulant determinant Δ = | a  b  c ; b  c  a ; c  a  b | is always:
oe: Greater than or equal to zero

q: आव्यूह A = [[2, 4, −6], [7, 3, 5], [1, −2, 4]] को अद्वितीय रूप से A = P + Q के रूप में व्यक्त किया गया है, जहाँ P एक सममित आव्यूह और Q एक विषम-सममित आव्यूह है। [trace(P) + q₂₃] का मान क्या है (जहाँ q₂₃, Q की दूसरी पंक्ति व तीसरे स्तंभ का अवयव है)?
e: Here P = (1/2)(A + Aᵀ) and Q = (1/2)(A − Aᵀ). The diagonal elements of P are identical to those of A (सममित भाग P के विकर्ण अवयव A के समान होते हैं): 2, 3, 4. Thus, trace(P) = 2 + 3 + 4 = 9. For Q, q₂₃ = (1/2)(a₂₃ − a₃₂) = (1/2)(5 − (−2)) = 7/2. Therefore, trace(P) + q₂₃ = 9 + 7/2 = 25/2.
qe: The matrix A = [[2, 4, −6], [7, 3, 5], [1, −2, 4]] is uniquely expressed as A = P + Q, where P is a symmetric matrix and Q is a skew-symmetric matrix. What is the value of [trace(P) + q₂₃] (where q₂₃ is the element in the 2nd row, 3rd column of Q)?

q: यदि आव्यूह A = (1/3) [[1, 2, 2], [2, 1, −2], [a, 2, b]] एक लांबिक (orthogonal) आव्यूह है, तो क्रमित युग्म (a, b) क्या है?
e: For an orthogonal matrix, A·Aᵀ = I, meaning rows are mutually orthogonal unit vectors (लांबिक आव्यूह की पंक्तियाँ परस्पर लंबवत इकाई सदिश होती हैं). Dot product of Row 1 and Row 3 = 0 ⇒ 1(a) + 2(2) + 2(b) = 0 ⇒ a + 2b = −4 ... (i). Dot product of Row 2 and Row 3 = 0 ⇒ 2(a) + 1(2) − 2(b) = 0 ⇒ 2a − 2b = −2 ⇒ a − b = −1 ... (ii). Subtracting (ii) from (i): 3b = −3 ⇒ b = −1, and a = −1 + (−1) = −2. Check norm: (−2)² + 2² + (−1)² = 9 = 3². Hence (a, b) = (−2, −1).
qe: If the matrix A = (1/3) [[1, 2, 2], [2, 1, −2], [a, 2, b]] is an orthogonal matrix, then what is the ordered pair (a, b)?

q: यदि A एक व्युत्क्रमणीय (non-singular) 3×3 आव्यूह है जहाँ |A| = 2 हो, तो |adj(3·A⁻¹)| का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
e: Let B = 3·A⁻¹. Since A is of order n = 3, |B| = |3·A⁻¹| = 3³ · |A⁻¹| = 27 / |A| = 27/2. Using the property |adj(B)| = |B|^(n−1) (गुणधर्म |adj(B)| = |B|^(n−1) से): |adj(3·A⁻¹)| = |B|² = (27/2)² = 729/4.
qe: If A is a non-singular 3×3 matrix with |A| = 2, then find the value of |adj(3·A⁻¹)|.

q: आव्यूह A = [[2, −1], [−1, 2]] आव्यूह समीकरण A² − 4A + 3I = O को संतुष्ट करता है। इस संबंध का उपयोग करने पर A⁻¹ बराबर है:
qe: The matrix A = [[2, −1], [−1, 2]] satisfies the matrix equation A² − 4A + 3I = O. Using this relation, A⁻¹ is equal to:

e: For rank(A) to be 2, |A| must be 0 while at least one 2×2 minor is non-zero (कोटि 2 होने के लिए |A| = 0 तथा कम से कम एक 2×2 उपसारणिक अशून्य होना चाहिए). Applying R₂ → R₂ − 2R₁ and R₃ → R₃ − 3R₁ transforms A into [[1, 2, 3], [0, k − 4, 1], [0, 0, 1]]. Its determinant is 1·(k − 4)·1 = k − 4. Setting |A| = 0 gives k = 4. At k = 4, the 2×2 minor from rows 1, 3 and columns 2, 3 is | 2  3 ; 6  10 | = 20 − 18 = 2 ≠ 0, confirming rank(A) = 2.
qe: Find the value of k for which the rank of the 3×3 matrix A = [[1, 2, 3], [2, k, 7], [3, 6, 10]] is 2.

q: यदि किसी 3×3 आव्यूह A के अभिलाक्षणिक मान (eigenvalues) 1, −2 तथा 3 हैं, तो आव्यूह B = A² − 2A + 3I का अनुरेख (trace) तथा सारणिक (determinant) क्रमशः हैं:
e: If λ is an eigenvalue of A, then f(λ) = λ² − 2λ + 3 is an eigenvalue of B = A² − 2A + 3I (यदि λ, A का अभिलाक्षणिक मान है, तो f(λ), f(A) का अभिलाक्षणिक मान होगा). Computing eigenvalues of B: for λ = 1 ⇒ 1 − 2 + 3 = 2; for λ = −2 ⇒ 4 + 4 + 3 = 11; for λ = 3 ⇒ 9 − 6 + 3 = 6. Therefore, trace(B) = sum of eigenvalues = 2 + 11 + 6 = 19, and det(B) = product of eigenvalues = 2 × 11 × 6 = 132.
qe: If the eigenvalues of a 3×3 matrix A are 1, −2, and 3, then the trace and determinant of the matrix B = A² − 2A + 3I are respectively:

q: यदि दो समांतर श्रेणियों (AP) के प्रथम n पदों के योगफलों का अनुपात (3n + 8) : (7n + 15) है, तो उनके 12वें पदों का अनुपात क्या होगा?
e: The ratio of sums is Sₙ / S'ₙ = [2a₁ + (n − 1)d₁] / [2a₂ + (n − 1)d₂] = (3n + 8)/(7n + 15). To obtain the ratio of m-th terms [a₁ + (m − 1)d₁] / [a₂ + (m − 1)d₂], substitute n = 2m − 1 (m-वें पद के अनुपात हेतु n = 2m − 1 रखने पर). For m = 12, n = 2(12) − 1 = 23. Thus, ratio = (3×23 + 8) / (7×23 + 15) = (69 + 8) / (161 + 15) = 77 / 176 = 7 / 16.
qe: If the ratio of the sums of the first n terms of two Arithmetic Progressions (APs) is (3n + 8) : (7n + 15), then what is the ratio of their 12th terms?
What is the sum of the first n terms of the series 7 + 77 + 777 + 7777 + ...?

q: यदि a, b, c हरात्मक श्रेणी (HP) में हैं जहाँ a ≠ b ≠ c, तो (b + a)/(b − a) + (b + c)/(b − c) का मान क्या होगा?
e: Since a, b, c are in HP, b = 2ac/(a + c) ⇒ b/a = 2c/(a + c). By Componendo and Dividendo (योगांतरानुपात से): (b + a)/(b − a) = (2c + a + c)/(2c − a − c) = (3c + a)/(c − a). Similarly, b/c = 2a/(a + c) ⇒ (b + c)/(b − c) = (3a + c)/(a − c) = −(3a + c)/(c − a). Adding both: (3c + a − 3a − c)/(c − a) = 2(c − a)/(c − a) = 2.
qe: If a, b, c are in Harmonic Progression (HP) with a ≠ b ≠ c, then what is the value of (b + a)/(b − a) + (b + c)/(b − c)?

q: श्रेणी 1² + (1² + 2²) + (1² + 2² + 3²) + ... के प्रथम n पदों का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
qe: Find the sum of the first n terms of the series: 1² + (1² + 2²) + (1² + 2² + 3²) + ...

q: समांतर-गुणोत्तर श्रेणी (AGP) 1 + 4/5 + 7/5² + 10/5³ + ... ∞ का अनंत तक योगफल क्या है?
e: This is an infinite AGP with first term a = 1, common difference d = 3, and common ratio r = 1/5 (|r| < 1). Using the formula (अनंत AGP के योग सूत्र से): S_∞ = a/(1 − r) + dr/(1 − r)² = 1/(1 − 1/5) + (3 × 1/5)/(1 − 1/5)² = 1/(4/5) + (3/5)/(16/25) = 5/4 + 15/16 = (20 + 15)/16 = 35/16.
qe: What is the sum to infinity of the Arithmetico-Geometric series 1 + 4/5 + 7/5² + 10/5³ + ... ∞?

e: The k-th term is T_k = 1/[k(k + 1)(k + 2)]. Splitting by telescoping difference (अंतर विधि द्वारा): T_k = (1/2) [1/(k(k + 1)) − 1/((k + 1)(k + 2))]. Summing from k = 1 to n, all intermediate terms cancel: Sₙ = (1/2)[1/(1·2) − 1/((n + 1)(n + 2))]. Taking the limit as n → ∞ (n → ∞ लेने पर), 1/((n + 1)(n + 2)) → 0, so S_∞ = (1/2)(1/2) = 1/4.
qe: Find the sum of the infinite series: 1/(1·2·3) + 1/(2·3·4) + 1/(3·4·5) + ... ∞.

q: 5 लड़कों और 5 लड़कियों को एक गोल मेज के चारों ओर कितने तरीकों से बैठाया जा सकता है ताकि कोई भी दो लड़कियाँ एक साथ न बैठें?
e: First, seat the 5 boys around the circular table in (5 − 1)! = 4! = 24 ways (पहले 5 लड़कों को वृत्ताकार मेज पर 4! तरीकों से बैठाएँ). This creates 5 distinct gaps between the boys. The 5 girls can be arranged in these 5 gaps in 5! = 120 ways so that no two girls are adjacent. By the multiplication principle, total ways = 4! × 5! = 24 × 120 = 2880.
qe: In how many ways can 5 boys and 5 girls be seated around a circular table such that no two girls sit together?

q: शब्द "ASSASSINATION" के अक्षरों को कितने भिन्न तरीकों से व्यवस्थित किया जा सकता है ताकि सभी 'S' सदैव एक साथ रहें?
e: "ASSASSINATION" has 13 letters: A(3), S(4), I(2), N(2), T(1), O(1). Treating the 4 identical S's as a single block [SSSS] (चारों S को एक इकाई मानने पर), we have 13 − 4 + 1 = 10 objects to arrange, among which A repeats 3 times, I repeats 2 times, and N repeats 2 times. Number of arrangements = 10! / (3! × 2! × 2!) = 3628800 / (6 × 2 × 2) = 3628800 / 24 = 151200.
qe: In how many distinct ways can the letters of the word "ASSASSINATION" be arranged so that all the S's are always together?

q: यदि शब्द "MOTHER" के सभी अक्षरों को हर संभव तरीके से व्यवस्थित कर शब्दकोश (dictionary) के क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो शब्द "MOTHER" की रैंक (स्थान) क्या होगी?
e:
Alphabetical order of letters: E, H, M, O, R, T (वर्णमाला क्रम). Count words strictly preceding "MOTHER":
- Starting with E or H (2 letters before M): 2 × 5! = 240.
- Fix M; remaining {E, H, O, R, T}; before O are E, H (2 letters): 2 × 4! = 48.
- Fix MO; remaining {E, H, R, T}; before T are E, H, R (3 letters): 3 × 3! = 18.
- Fix MOT; remaining {E, H, R}; before H is E (1 letter): 1 × 2! = 2.
- Fix MOTH; remaining {E, R}; before E (0 letters): 0 × 1! = 0.
- Fix MOTHE; remaining {R}: 1 word ("MOTHER" itself).
Total rank = 240 + 48 + 18 + 2 + 0 + 1 = 309.
qe: If all the letters of the word "MOTHER" are arranged in all possible ways and listed as in a dictionary, what is the rank of the word "MOTHER"?

q: 5 भिन्न पत्रों को उनके 5 पते लिखे लिफाफों में कितने तरीकों से रखा जा सकता है ताकि ठीक एक (EXACTLY ONE) पत्र अपने सही लिफाफे में जाए?
e: First, choose which 1 letter goes into its correct envelope in ⁵C₁ = 5 ways (सही लिफाफे में जाने वाले 1 पत्र का चयन = ⁵C₁ = 5). The remaining 4 letters must be completely deranged (शेष 4 पत्रों का पूर्ण अव्यवस्थापन D₄): D₄ = 4! [1 − 1/1! + 1/2! − 1/3! + 1/4!] = 24(1/2 − 1/6 + 1/24) = 12 − 4 + 1 = 9. Therefore, total ways = 5 × 9 = 45.
qe: Find the number of ways in which 5 distinct letters can be placed into 5 correspondingly addressed envelopes such that EXACTLY ONE letter goes into its correct envelope.

q: शर्तों x ≥ 2, y ≥ 3 तथा z ≥ 1 के अंतर्गत समीकरण x + y + z = 15 के पूर्णांक हलों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
e: Substitute x = x' + 2, y = y' + 3, z = z' + 1 where x', y', z' ≥ 0 (अऋणात्मक पूर्णांक चरों में रूपांतरण करने पर). The equation becomes (x' + 2) + (y' + 3) + (z' + 1) = 15 ⇒ x' + y' + z' = 9. By the stars-and-bars formula, the number of non-negative integral solutions is ⁽⁹⁺³⁻¹⁾C₍₃₋₁₎ = ¹¹C₂ = (11 × 10)/2 = 55.
qe: Find the number of integral solutions of the equation x + y + z = 15 subject to the conditions x ≥ 2, y ≥ 3, and z ≥ 1.

q: द्विपद प्रसार (3x²/2 − 1/(3x))⁹ में x से स्वतंत्र (अचर) पद क्या है?
qe: What is the term independent of x in the binomial expansion of (3x²/2 − 1/(3x))⁹?

q: यदि Cᵣ = ⁿCᵣ हो, तो द्विपद श्रेणी C₀ + 2C₁ + 3C₂ + ... + (n + 1)Cₙ का योगफल क्या है?
e: Split the sum (श्रेणी को दो भागों में विभाजित करने पर): ∑(r + 1)ⁿCᵣ (from r = 0 to n) = ∑r·ⁿCᵣ + ∑ⁿCᵣ. Using the standard identities ∑ⁿCᵣ = 2ⁿ and ∑r·ⁿCᵣ = n·2^(n−1), the total sum is n·2^(n−1) + 2ⁿ = 2^(n−1)(n + 2) = (n + 2)·2^(n−1).
qe: If Cᵣ = ⁿCᵣ, then what is the sum of the binomial series C₀ + 2C₁ + 3C₂ + ... + (n + 1)Cₙ?

e: Using the generalized binomial expansion (1 − y)^(-p) = ∑ [p(p + 1)...(p + n − 1) / n!] yⁿ with p = 1/2 and y = 4x: Coefficient of xⁿ = [(1/2)(3/2)(5/2)...((2n − 1)/2) / n!] × 4ⁿ = [1·3·5...(2n − 1) / (2ⁿ · n!)] × 2^(2n) = [1·3·5...(2n − 1) × 2ⁿ] / n!. Multiplying numerator and denominator by n! gives [1·3·5...(2n − 1) × 2·4·6...(2n)] / (n!)² = (2n)! / (n!)² (अर्थात् ²ⁿCₙ).
qe: For |x| < 1/4, what is the coefficient of xⁿ in the binomial expansion of (1 − 4x)^(-1/2)?
Find the sum of the infinite exponential series: 1 + (1 + 2)/2! + (1 + 2 + 3)/3! + (1 + 2 + 3 + 4)/4! + ... ∞.
What is the sum of the infinite logarithmic series 1/(1·2) − 1/(2·3) + 1/(3·4) − 1/(4·5) + ... ∞?
